name: trendvault-ai
description: Connect Codex to a scoped TrendVault AI instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped TrendVault AI tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to TrendVault AI through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so TrendVault AI Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use TrendVault AI only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
